items.title: GitLab warns of critical RCE vulnerability in AI Gateway service
items.summary: GitLab released patched AI Gateway versions 19.2.4, 19.3.2 and 19.4.1 for CVE-2026-90970 (CVSS 9.9), which lets authenticated users with Duo Agent Platform access escape the prompt-template sandbox and run arbitrary commands on self-hosted instances. GitLab.com and GitLab-hosted gateways are already remediated.

items.title: Cisco patches actively exploited Catalyst SD-WAN Manager zero-day
items.summary: Cisco rolled out urgent patches for CVE-2026-76504 (CVSS 9.8), an authentication bypass in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager that lets unauthenticated attackers gain admin API access via improper URI-encoding handling. CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 30; there is no workaround.

items.title: Warlock ransomware breaches SharePoint in water, telecom operator attacks
items.summary: The China-linked Warlock ransomware group exploited SharePoint vulnerabilities to breach a water utility, a telecom provider, a regional government body and a university, targeting Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking countries. In one intrusion, the attackers used an EDR-killing tool to disable protection on at least 40 hosts within about two hours.

items.title: McMinnville confirms data breach after RansomHouse leak; notification timeline questioned
items.summary: The city of McMinnville, Oregon issued a formal public notice on September 29 after the RansomHouse ransomware group listed it on its dark-web leak site in August. The exposed records reportedly include names, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, tax returns, bank records and police files; the ~76-day gap before notification drew local scrutiny.

items.title: Biometrics firm Aware listed on ransomware leak site by thegentlemen group
items.summary: The ransomware group thegentlemen claimed an attack on Aware, Inc., the US biometrics software company behind FBI fingerprint standards whose technology serves around 80 government agencies. The incident report cites a September 30 breach date with the claim surfacing October 3.
